Who Plays Like Him

Pick a player. Every other player in his position group is ranked by how closely his statistical profile matches — then filtered down to the ones you could actually sign. Similarity is nearest-neighbour in a standardised, position-specific feature space, and every match opens a metric-by-metric account of why.

Percentiles are against players in the same position group in this pool. Where a metric is one a scout wants low — errors, miscontrols, fouls — the percentile is already flipped, so a high number is always good.

Click any row to make that player the subject above. Percentiles are against his own position group, so a defender and a forward are never ranked on the same scale — which is why the position filter matters here.
Where the data comes from. FBref match statistics joined to Transfermarkt squad records through a curated 15,440-row player mapping, both mirrored by worldfootballR_data. Positions are Transfermarkt's, taken from an independent source rather than inferred from the same statistics the models read — so grouping players by position is not circular.
How similarity is calculated. Each player is a vector of his position group's metrics, standardised so every metric counts equally, and similarity is the cosine between two such vectors × 100. Nothing is hand-tuned: a 90% match means the two profiles point in nearly the same direction across all of them. Comparisons only ever happen inside a position group, because a centre-back and a winger share no meaningful axis.
What the money means. A figure in euros is Transfermarkt's market value estimate for that season - not a fee anybody paid, and partly informed by the same public data shown here. A figure in pounds marked with an asterisk is the fantasy game's price, which is what the Premier League dataset carries instead: a popularity and perceived-value signal set by the game's operator, not a valuation at all.
Sharing a view. The address bar tracks the dataset, the player and the comparison, so Copy link hands someone the exact screen you are looking at. Copy as CSV puts the current shortlist on the clipboard, filters and all.
A static extract of a larger Streamlit platform, which adds recruitment search, squad analysis, archetype maps and a model-validation suite across five seasons and ten position groups.
